verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe adding a custom MCP connector to Grok, with Grok's servers reaching your MCP server over the public internet. A dedicated tunneling guide covers exposing local MCP servers, and connectors let you expose your own tools with custom schemas. Missing for 10: detailed docs on MCP setup, auth and transport options, tool-selection behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tools work reliably in practice.
